feedback: Say what the caller told you: four people stuck between floors, nobody hurt, one panicking, car getting hot, alarm button dead. The message leaves all of this out, and that is why the code check failed.

Take out the details the data doesn't back up: the name "Douglas Emmett - Century Park Plaza", the phone number 555-085-6585, suites 450 and 460, and "daytime". Say only "Property manager on file, no name or number listed." A crew could try to call a number that doesn't exist.

"No risk flags" has no support in the data, and it clashes with a hot car and a panicking passenger. Cut the tenant list and headcount for floor 4 as well. The people stuck are in the car, and the crew needs the car and the keys, not the office occupants.
